name: tend-yc-demo
description: TEND YC demo video (Remotion). Not part of the app build.

scripts.preview: ffmpeg -y -i out/TEND_YC_DEMO_FINAL.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 22 -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart out/TEND_YC_DEMO_PREVIEW.mp4
scripts.final: remotion render TendDemo out/render_raw.mp4 --crf=14 --x264-preset=slow --audio-bitrate=256k && bash scripts/finalize.sh
